method.passive: Passive profile: no HTTP requests, crawling, screenshots, or active port scanning were sent to the target web service. DNS queries were sent to recursive resolvers; other requests were directed to public-data providers.
method.verify: Verification profile: each DNS-validated domain receives a limited root-page web check under a shared watchdog. TCP port scanning and internal-page crawling are disabled.
method.full: Full profile: DNS-validated names are admitted to a bounded authorized active-assessment plan while scope, request budgets, and low-noise controls remain enforced.
method.default: The assessment profile is defined by the ASM Tool configuration.
copy.lead: Human-readable summary of key results. The complete technical dataset is retained in final_report.json, SQLite/JSONL, and subdomains.csv.
copy.domains_truncated: A total of {total} subdomains were discovered. The human-readable summary shows the {shown} highest-priority names in deterministic pre-DNS ranking order. The complete list remains available in {csv} and final_report.json.
copy.domains_full: All {total} discovered in-scope subdomains are included in this full human-readable report.
copy.ips_truncated: The human-readable summary shows {shown} of {total} IP addresses. The complete set remains in final_report.json and in the A/AAAA fields of subdomains.csv.
copy.routing_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} routing objects; the complete set remains in final_report.json.
copy.routing_context: ASN and CIDR values describe IP routing context. They do not establish ownership of the full network range by the operator of the assessed domain.
copy.related_warning: These names were derived from PTR records or shared-IP observations. Their ownership by the assessed organization is not established, so they are excluded from active verification.
copy.ports_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} observations; the complete set remains in final_report.json.
copy.ports_context: InternetDB port data are historical observations at the IP-address level. On shared infrastructure they do not prove that every observed port serves the assessed domain.
copy.web_coverage_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} web-coverage rows; the complete set remains in final_report.json.
copy.documents_note: These URLs were not processed as HTML pages and do not require screenshots. ASM Tool did not download the files.
copy.documents_truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} resources; the complete set remains in final_report.json.
copy.screenshots_truncated: The human-readable summary includes {shown} of {total} screenshots; the complete set remains in artifacts/screenshots.
copy.research_intro: This section presents the academic collector-comparison profile. Collector benchmark statistics, provider evidence, and DNS evidence remain separate. DNS yield is calculated by the same wildcard-aware ASM DNS layer.
copy.research_metric_note: Useful/s is the number of clean-parent or wildcard-distinct DNS candidates attributed to a collector, evaluated by the common ASM DNS layer, divided by collector wall-clock time. Full pairwise overlap/Jaccard data and network deltas remain in technical research JSON/CSV artifacts.
copy.limitations_intro: Passive sources may contain incomplete or historical information. Absence from the report does not establish absence in reality. Failure of one external source does not stop collection and is recorded separately.
report.full_warning: Full report mode is enabled. The human-readable report will include all {count} in-scope domains and may be very large.
